institution.name: The Kennedy Institute of Rheumatology, University of Oxford

qualifications: For students from Africa (joint partnership with the Africa Oxford Initiative)
Applicants must contact the supervisor of any project before applying
Application is complete only when all sections, transcript and personal statement are submitted, at least 2 of 3 referees have submitted references and the fee is paid
AfOx applicants must select Reuben College
